summary: Joseph A. Viola, 54, long-time local, found deceased late Sunday afternoon near the Eagle River in Edwards; body recovered from the river after a large multi-agency search
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle River Fire Protection District
notes: Recorded at the body-recovery date (Sun 2019-11-24; weekday-verified). Eagle County Sheriff press release issued Monday: a massive cooperative search preceded the recovery; agencies included Eagle County Paramedics, Eagle County Sheriff Office, Eagle County Coroner, Colorado State Patrol, Avon and Eagle police departments, ECO Transit, and Vail Public Safety Communications Center. Coroner leading cause-of-death investigation; foul play not ruled out at publication. Distinct from id 2388 (2019-07-26 unidentified Eagle River body).
